description: This file defines the 'SerializerGenerator' class and related classes responsible for generating serializer code for types in the Orleans framework. It contains methods to create serializer classes for types, serialize and deserialize methods, and helper structures to represent fields and members involved in serialization.

classes.name: SerializerGenerator
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating serializer classes for serializable types, including methods for create, serialize, deserialize, and code structure management.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Creates a serializer class declaration syntax for a given serializable type description.

methods.name: GetSimpleClassName
methods.description: Returns the simple name for the serializer class based on the type name.

methods.name: GetGeneratedNamespaceName
methods.description: Computes the namespace for generated serializers based on the type's namespace.

methods.name: GenerateSerializeMethod
methods.description: Generates the implementation of the Serialize method for a given type.

methods.name: GenerateDeserializeMethod
methods.description: Generates the implementation of the Deserialize method for a given type.

methods.name: GenerateEnumWriteMethod
methods.description: Generates code to serialize enum values.

methods.name: GenerateEnumReadMethod
methods.description: Generates code to deserialize enum values.

methods.name: GenerateCompoundTypeWriteFieldMethod
methods.description: Creates the method to write individual fields of a compound type.

methods.name: GenerateCompoundTypeReadValueMethod
methods.description: Creates the method to read individual values of a compound type.

inner classes.name: GeneratedFieldDescription
inner classes.description: Abstract base class representing a generated field, including its type, name, and whether it is injected.

inner classes.name: BaseCodecFieldDescription
inner classes.description: Represents the base codec field in a generated serializer.

inner classes.name: ActivatorFieldDescription
inner classes.description: Represents a field for an activator, injected into the serializer.

inner classes.name: CodecFieldDescription
inner classes.description: Represents a codec field with its underlying type.

inner classes.name: CodecFieldTypeFieldDescription
inner classes.description: Represents a field storing the codec type.

inner classes.name: FieldAccessorDescription
inner classes.description: Stores info about accessor methods for a member.

inner classes.name: ISerializableMember
inner classes.description: Interface for a serializable member (field or property).

inner classes.name: SerializableMethodMember
inner classes.description: Implementation of ISerializableMember for method-based members.

inner classes.name: SerializableMember
inner classes.description: Implementation of ISerializableMember for a field or property.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Main entry point to generate the serializer class syntax for a given type description.
